purpose: Teach: 松岡/呉/伊東/藤沢/永井/尾崎/黒田/英寿

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、TOKIO松岡さんのドラマ観てたな
lines.en: Riku — you were watching that TOKIO Matsuoka drama, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation, teasing lilt. Leaning in slightly. Not mean, but catching him in something he maybe didn't want noticed. Light and knowing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で広島県呉の歴史調べてたな、桜
lines.en: Oh? You were researching Kure's history in Hiroshima for social studies, Sakura.
lines.style: Mild, evenly matched counter-accusation. Slight smirk in the voice without saying it. Turning the tables with ease. Not defensive, just leveling.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で伊東温泉に行ってたな
lines.en: Riku — your whole family went to Ito Hot Spring, right?
lines.style: Picking up speed now, energy rising. Still teasing but warmer. Enjoying the volley. Quick delivery, slight challenge in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図書館で藤沢周平読んでたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were reading Fujisawa Shuhei in the library, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Faster now, keeping pace. The rhythm of back-and-forth building. Light, almost breathless. Not backing down—matching her energy exactly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語で永井荷風習ったろ
lines.en: Riku — you studied Nagai Kafu in Japanese class.
lines.style: Quickening further, riding the momentum. Breath coming slightly faster. Delighted at how well he knows her moves. The teasing has real warmth now.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽の授業で尾崎豊聴いたな、桜
lines.en: You listened to Ozaki Yutaka in music class, Sakura.
lines.style: Matching her pace precisely. Small, genuine laugh underneath the words. The rhythm is almost musical now—they've found their tempo together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、野球で広島の黒田投手応援してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were cheering for Kuroda when the Hiroshima Carp played, weren't you?
lines.style: Breath quickening even more. Grinning through her words. This is less teasing now, more celebrating how completely she knows him. Genuine affection breaking through.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サッカーで中田英寿のフォーム真似してたな、桜
lines.en: You were mimicking Nakada Hidekazu's form during soccer practice, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final volley, delivered with warmth and surrender. He's not defending anymore—just admitting she knows him just as well. Small, helpless laugh. Total softness.
